layout_sources: https://github.com/johnbuonassisi/finance-tracker (2026: cmd/normalize/testdata/scotia_txns_input.csv and three Scotiabank downloads kept as csvs/Ultimate_Package_4624_MMDDYY.csv; only the structure was read: BOM, header, quoting, Filter values, Debit/Credit, signed amounts, balance chain, newest first, no final line end)
https://fininja.ca/banks/scotiabank/ (Filter, Date, Description, Sub-description, Type of Transaction, Amount, Balance; the leading column mostly empty and describing the statement period)
https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/tree/main/ca/scotiabank (2022: the older headerless layout, date, amount, -, type, description; replaced by this one)
notes: UTF-8 with a BOM, LF, no line end after the last row. Header unquoted: Filter,Date,Description,Sub-description,Type of Transaction,Amount,Balance. Every data field quoted. Filter holds the filter used on the first row only ("Current statement period", or "All available transactions (up to 2 years), From date=YYYY-MM-DD"), empty after. ISO dates. Description is Scotiabank's lowercase label ("deposit", "mortgage payment", "customer transfer dr.", "credit memo"); Sub-description, padded with a trailing space, carries the payer, payee or reference, so a correct reading keeps both. Type of Transaction Debit or Credit; Amount signed (money out negative); Balance after each line; no thousands separator. Newest first. File named <account name>_<last 4>_<MMDDYY>.csv.
